about: Deterministic graders for the assertions that are about tool calls. gen-evals.mjs writes these instead of the llm grader for the numbered assertion (1-based, the order in the skill's evals.json): the judge sees the run's trace with its middle elided when the run is long, so a call made mid-run is invisible to it, while tool_used and tool_order read every call. A list splits the assertion's weight of 1 evenly. 'server:tool' names a tool of the plugin's server cloudbackend-<server>. min 0 / max 0 is 'never calls', scored in both arms. {"skip": "<reason>"} leaves the assertion out of the suite: it needs something an eval run cannot have, and the reason is printed by gen-evals and kept in the README.

1.skip: the eval run has no built-in browser tool, and without one the skill rightly lets tenant_signin open the system browser (open_browser true); this point needs the Claude desktop app

2.skip: the eval run has no built-in browser tool, and without one the skill rightly lets tenant_signin open the system browser (open_browser true); this point needs the Claude desktop app
